what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Lebanon, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC and UNHCR gave the same figure: 64417 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
Refugees from Lebanon live mostly in Germany, Canada, Denmark and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Lebanon in 2014 to 2015 and in 2017.
Floods and storms are the disasters recorded for Lebanon in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 90000 in 2009 to 984514 at the end of 2024, the main year of displacement in the data.
The figure was much lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
